title: Wall Mount Multi Hook 6-Position 15.5-Inch Solid Brass Mercury Collection | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
description:
Add storage where you need it with this wall mount multi hook featuring 6 positions and solid brass construction, designed to coordinate with the Mercury Collection in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look after installation
- Solid brass construction
- Designer finish helps provide corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Pairs with coordinated pieces from the Mercury Collection for a transitional bathroom hardware feel

Specs:
- Category: Multi Hooks
- Collection: Mercury
- Style: Contemporary
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 15.5 in (L) x 4 in (W) x 3.2 in (H)
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 3 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Multi hook and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available (25 total, including statement colors).
